equivalents.reason: The mutant adds a fee line's reference, and a non-fee line's empty reference, to the set. A fee line never looks up a payment, in Check or in posting, and no payment has an empty reference (CompleteAsync refuses a blank one), so the extra references add only locks and rows nobody reads. Those locks come in the same order as the rest, references before payments, so they can make another caller wait but cannot change a result or close a cycle.

With it no payment counts as returned, and the status test beside it in Check refuses every payment that has a posted return anyway. Posting a return sets Returned in the same transaction. Afterwards CompleteAsync leaves such a payment Returned, or in review under evidence_after_return, conflicting_evidence or unsupported_settlement, never Settled and never under a return_ reason. FailAsync and RetryAsync leave it alone because it has a receipt, and closing a review makes it ReviewClosed. Only the two engines write a payment's status.
